name: Surgical Science
description: Surgical Science Sweden AB is a medical simulation company founded in 1999 in Gothenburg, Sweden. Following acquisitions including SenseGraphics, Mimic Technologies, and Simbionix, the company provides virtual reality simulators such as [FlexVR (RobotiX Mentor)](/robot/surgical_science_robotix_mentor) and [LAP Mentor](/robot/surgical_science_lap_mentor), as well as OEM simulation software for clinical robotic surgery platforms.
